steps.title: Analyze User Error Report
steps.description: Inspect reported database or cursor crash logs in Student Study Planner.

steps.title: Diagnose SQLite Connection Lifecycle
steps.description: Identify premature db.close() invocations within DatabaseHelper write, update, and delete methods which cause attempt to re-open closed database errors.

steps.title: Refactor Database Write Queries
steps.description: Remove redundant manual database connection closing calls inside insertion helper methods to prevent locking active cursor datasets.

steps.title: Refactor Database Update & Delete Operations
steps.description: Adjust task status updates and deletion methods to preserve the shared SQLite database connection throughout the Activity lifecycle.

steps.title: Enhance Cursor Access Safety
steps.description: Replace getColumnIndexOrThrow with safer getColumnIndex lookups to protect against layout rendering interruptions.

steps.title: Improve Task Selection Spinner Integrity
steps.description: Add index boundary verification inside filterSpinner to prevent any IndexOutOfBoundsException when resetting filters.

steps.title: Validate Layout Element Binding
steps.description: Confirm layout XML views and container structures align cleanly with layout IDs inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Streamline Countdown Timer and Ringtone Resources
steps.description: Verify concentration Pomodoro state variables are correctly initialized and released on activity destruction.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Definitions
steps.description: Ensure launch intent-filters, correct Android namespace configuration, and screen orientations are set properly.

steps.title: Compile Clean-Up Tests
steps.description: Run diagnostic compilations of updated Java resource adapters, list containers, and progress visualizers.

steps.title: Building Student Study Planner
steps.description: Trigger final Gradle compilation process to verify package assembly and build the crash-free executable.
